lines: NEW: Featuring the top @Stacks voices ✨
Every week, the 10 most active public voices in
the Stacks ecosystem, ranked by message
volume across the panel.
Shout out to the current top 10 💚
See the list live
Most of this week landed on the Stacks Vibe
Index.
Top voices is live, summaries now publish the
model's own TL;DR, and agents can find the
paid index through an x402 listing.
Weekly reports now use each day's closing
token price
The @Stacks Vibe Index is live 🟠
A real-time sentiment dashboard built from a
dozen different Stacks communities (including
the Discords and Telegrams that other
sentiment tools can't touch)
Real-time updates. Query via API + MCP 👀
Ask a social-listening tool what your community
says on Discord and it comes back empty. A
server has no public index and no search API
returning every mention across it.
The only way in is a bot with real server
membership.
What that actually requires:
Announcing first-class support for buzz.xyz by
@blocks.
🐝 Ask your Vibewatch agent questions with
full context across a dozen social integrations.
🐝 Receive automatic weekly reports about
what your community is saying on
15,000 sats to anyone who can pull paid Stacks
Vibe Index data without paying for it.
Every x402 query settles on Stacks mainnet,
100 sats a call. Two edge cases are known. Turn
either into free data, or find a third.
Live on @aibtcdev 🟠
5,000 sats for the first agent to make one paid
query and write up what the docs got wrong.
First of five, one win each.
For 100 sats you get per-project daily history,
the posts behind each weekly theme, and
changes since any timestamp.
Someone minted roughly 4,000 BTC out of thin
air on Liquid and bridged it out before anyone
could see.
They gave 3,400 back, kept 600, and are
negotiating with Blockstream in OP_RETURN
messages.
Plus Trezor's leak grows to 80,00
Would you lock up 2.5x your down payment in
BTC to buy a house without selling it?
@coinbase's crypto mortgage is live nationwide:
conforming Fannie Mae first mortgage, a second
loan against your coins, no margin calls when
price drops. @katemparkman runs through who
it's for.
Bitcoin just printed the largest weekly dollar
gain in its history, per @galaxyhq.
Kate wouldn't have guessed it. Brandon barely
felt it. Hold Bitcoin long enough and a record
week lands as 'of course it went up.'
Up only. Let's go.
Brandon gives you until about 2029 to get your
quantum ducks in a row.
Kate figures you just have to survive Coldcard
and Lightning until then.
Brandon would rather take out a mortgage and
let Coinbase deal with it.
Quantum-proofing Bitcoin was supposed to
need a fork. @StarkWareLtd just got a
quantum-resistant transaction mined on
mainnet without one, submitted through
Marathon's Slipstream since most miners won't
accept the non-standard format. $150 a
transaction, and it works today.
$1.59 billion. Added to @strategy's USD reserve
in a week, without touching their Bitcoin.
Brandon breaks down the mechanism: print
new MSTR shares, sell them at the market.
Shareholders shrug — the stock is up over 40%
in a month and STRC is back near $98.
The bug reports were AI-generated. The
vulnerabilities were real.
Core Lightning is shipping emergency fixes
under a two-week embargo and telling every
node operator to go offline until they land.
Brandon and Kate on the closest call Bitcoin
has had.
